label: Rules of engagement
note: A preview: moving it here changes nothing. Choose yours on the Posture screen in the app.

stops.name: Safety on
stops.subtitle: slow and careful
stops.summary: A quarter of each cap, long gaps between actions, quiet nights and no outreach.

dials.label: Between public actions
dials.value: 15 to 30 minutes, per profile on each platform

stops.name: Weapons tight
stops.subtitle: normal pace, within the platform's own limits
stops.summary: The default. Normal pace and half of each cap, with outreach only where it is established.

dials.label: Runs at once
dials.value: Profiles on one platform take turns

stops.name: Weapons free
stops.subtitle: fast, and more noticeable to the platform
stops.summary: The full cap, outreach on and a shorter pause after a challenge. Still never past a platform's published limit.

dials.label: Runs at once
dials.value: Profiles on one platform may run together

warmup: New profiles and new computers run Safety on for their first 14 days, caps ramping up, whatever you choose.

promise.title: A hard cap above every stop
promise.body: Blowhorn follows its Field Manual and each platform's best practices. Every cap sits under Blowhorn's own ceiling for that platform, and above everything stands a hard cap from the limits the platform itself publishes. No stop, not even Weapons free, pushes past them and puts your accounts at risk. Your own caps can only lower them, never raise them.
